note: Finding: `Camp.Cart.play` gives [M]'s first two lines (top map `headA`, downward recursion `car`). [L]'s coupling coordinate is affine, β = slope + pulse·x with pulse = β̂^{98/100} (`Camp.speaks`), so `Camp.Cart.veil` is z_i = pulse_i⁻¹(b − ∑_{j<i} tally_j) on complex points, without [M]'s factor (2z_m)^{-1}, term χ_m u_m² or square-root coordinate β_m = β̂_m(χ_m x_m)².

snippet.text: def play (z:PlotN N) (i:ℕ)(hi:i≤N): X i:= Nat.decreasingInduction (motive:=fun i _=> X i) (fun j hj x=> V.car j hj (z ⟨j+1,Nat.lt_add_one_iff.mpr hj⟩,x)) (V.headA (z ⟨N,Nat.lt_succ_self N⟩,0)) hi
def veil (b:ℂ) (z:PlotN N): PlotN N:= fun i=> (pulse T i.val:ℂ)⁻¹*(b-∑ j∈ range i.val,V.tally T N X z j)

verdicts.summary: [L] states a different form; neither implies the other. [M] prints `u_m&=(2z_m)^{-1}\left[b_m^{-1} \left(\mathfrak e-\sum_{i<m}\widehat{\mathcal D}_{N,i}(u_{i+1},W_{i+1})\right)-\chi_m u_m^2\right]`.
evidence: [M]'s first two lines (W_N = F_N^W(u_N), W_m = F_{N,m}(u_{m+1},W_{m+1})) match Cart.play (headA at the top, car downward via Nat.decreasingInduction). [M]'s third line is u_m=(2z_m)^{-1}[b_m^{-1}(e - sum_{i<m} D_{N,i}) - chi_m u_m^2], from the square-root coordinate beta_m = refbeta_m(chi_m x_m)^2 with the quadratic term retained, on formal series S(R). [L] has only `veil b z i = (pulse T i)^{-1} * (b - sum_{j<i} tally T N X z j)`, linear in the coordinate (also used this way in Crown/Fame.lean:47, Crown/Train.lean:40, Crown/Top.lean:16 locket), on complex points of Harbor N, with no (2z_m)^{-1} factor or quadratic term anywhere. The difference is deliberate in [M] (line 865: 'it retains its quadratic term'), so it is not a typo.

[M] prints three series equations on S(X) (formal power series in z): the Wilson top map, the downward activity recursion, and u_m=(2z_m)^{-1}[b_m^{-1}(e - sum D-hat) - chi_m u_m^2], which keeps the quadratic term from expanding beta_m=refbeta_m(chi_m x_m)^2 (eq:D-coupling-coordinate). [L]'s veil is `fun i=> (pulse T i:C)^{-1}*(b - sum_{j<i} V.tally ...)`, linear in the complex coupling b with no 1/(2z_m) factor and no quadratic term, on complex-valued PlotN, and play matches only the first two lines. No other declaration states the square-root coordinate or the series equations (grep of veil uses shows only unrelated RG12 declarations). The quadratic term is deliberate in [M] ('it retains its quadratic term'), so this is a genuine difference, not a typo.
